report.headline: IMPROVE-IT met its primary endpoint in 18,144 ACS patients (ezetimibe/simvastatin vs simvastatin), but the magnitude of benefit and on-trial LDL-C difference remain unpublished as of the 2014-11-17 data cutoff.
report.summary: The phase 3 IMPROVE-IT trial randomized 18,144 acute coronary syndrome patients to ezetimibe/simvastatin or simvastatin monotherapy, targeting 5,250 primary endpoint events over a median 2.5-year follow-up. Merck announced the trial met its primary composite endpoint of cardiovascular death, nonfatal MI, unstable angina rehospitalization, coronary revascularization (≥30 days), or stroke. However, no hazard ratio, confidence interval, or on-treatment LDL-C difference in the IMPROVE-IT population has been verified in the available facts. The calculator cannot compute an expected effect because the trial's LDL-C change was not measured (category: insufficient_data, MDE HR 0.926 at 80% power). Genetic evidence for NPC1L1 is uncertain (Open Targets score 0.0). Confidence in the success assessment is medium, limited by the absence of published effect size and biomarker data.
key_evidence: Primary endpoint: first occurrence of cardiovascular death, nonfatal MI, rehospitalization for unstable angina, coronary revascularization (≥30 days), or stroke (Rationale and design of IMPROVE-IT)
5,250 planned primary endpoint events (Rationale and design of IMPROVE-IT)
Median follow-up: 2.5 years (Rationale and design of IMPROVE-IT)
Trial met primary endpoint per Merck announcement (Merck Announces that IMPROVE-IT Achieved Primary Endpoint)
No observed HR, 95% CI, or on-treatment LDL-C difference in verified facts (calculator)
Genetic association score for NPC1L1 and coronary artery disorder: 0.0 (opentargets:NPC1L1)

Phase 2 LDL-C reductions with ezetimibe added to statin: -22.7% to -29.1% (Effects of ezetimibe added to statin therapy on markers of cholesterol absorption and synthesis and LDL-C lowering in hyperlipidemic patients)
Minimum detectable effect HR at 80% power: 0.926 (calculator)

mechanism.target_genetics_rationale: Open Targets shows NPC1L1 genetic association score 0.0 for coronary artery disorder specifically (overall 0.427). The single evidence item (FINNGEN_R12_I9_CORATHER, n=479478) has no publication date and is flagged before_cutoff: False. No genetic evidence for CAD before the 2014-11-17 cutoff; target is well-studied but evidence not supportive of causal or not_causal per rules.

mechanism.notes: No verified fact provides a placebo-adjusted LDL-C change for ezetimibe 10 mg added to simvastatin 40 mg (the IMPROVE-IT regimen) or for the IMPROVE-IT trial itself. Available phase 2 data (EASE monotherapy, add-on to atorvastatin) are within-arm changes only (placebo_adjusted: false) and in different populations. The ctgov record shows conflicting LDL-C inclusion thresholds (100 and 125 mg/dL) but no measured baseline. Follow-up (2.5 years) and events (5250 planned) come from a 2008 design paper (pmid:19061694). The 2014-11-17 announcement confirms the primary endpoint was met but provides no effect size or event counts.

issues.issue: Hypotheses reference historical IMPROVE-IT results (HR ~0.93, 95% CI ~0.89-0.98) in departure_from_calculator, but these values are NOT in verified facts. Only 'primary_endpoint: met' (f_c112fabab8c4ce) is verified. Using external knowledge violates evidence cutoff discipline.
issues.request: Remove all references to specific HR/CI values not in verified facts. Restrict arguments to what is verified: trial met primary endpoint, planned events, sample size, follow-up.

issues.issue: Follow-up duration mischaracterized: f_0ae9e22c3efa1e is labeled 'median_followup' but Verifier confirms source (pmid:19061694) states 'minimum of 2.5 years', not median. Calculator input followup_years: 2.5 and hypotheses claim '2.5-year median follow-up' — both incorrect.
issues.request: Correct the follow-up characterization. Search for actual median follow-up in IMPROVE-IT publications before 2014-11-17. Update fact label and calculator input accordingly.

issues.issue: Safety signals cited (f_18dbaab371649d, f_352f41fde5386c) are for ezetimibe/simvastatin PLUS NIACIN triple therapy, not IMPROVE-IT (ezetimibe/simvastatin vs simvastatin). Hypotheses incorrectly use these to argue 'no safety signal specific to IMPROVE-IT'.
issues.request: Remove or correct safety signal references. Search verified facts for IMPROVE-IT-specific safety data; if none, state 'no IMPROVE-IT safety data in verified facts' without citing irrelevant trials.

issues.issue: No placebo-adjusted LDL-C change from phase 2 ezetimibe add-on to statin in verified facts. Calculator correctly returns 'insufficient_data', but per protocol the accepted input is placebo-adjusted phase 2 change at outcome-trial dose. Literature before cutoff (e.g., pmid:18376000, NCT00552097) reports ~16.5% additional LDL-C lowering with ezetimibe added to simvastatin in FH — this should have been captured.
issues.request: Search for and add placebo-adjusted LDL-C change from phase 2 ezetimibe add-on to statin studies (dose 10mg ezetimibe + statin vs statin alone) published before 2014-11-17. Include baseline LDL-C, percent change, and source.

issues.issue: Genetic evidence incomplete: f_81ffde8e8667da shows Open Targets score 0.0 for NPC1L1→coronary artery disorder, but Kastelein et al. 2014 (pmid:25399658, published 2014-11-12, before cutoff) reported NPC1L1 inactivating mutations associated with lower LDL-C and lower CHD risk. This key genetic evidence is missing from verified facts, leading to target_genetics='uncertain' instead of 'causal'.
issues.request: Search for and add genetic association evidence for NPC1L1 loss-of-function variants and CHD outcomes published before 2014-11-17. Update genetic_association_score fact.

issues.issue: Two different LDL-C inclusion thresholds for IMPROVE-IT in verified facts: 100 mg/dl (f_5496bc4e428724) and 125 mg/dl (f_99a7f6fd5a445e), both from ctgov registry. May reflect different criteria (e.g., on/off statin) but unexplained.
issues.request: Clarify the two inclusion thresholds — determine if they represent different strata (e.g., statin-naive vs on-statin) and annotate facts accordingly.

issues.issue: Calculator input followup_years=2.5 is labeled as median follow-up but the verified fact (f_0ae9e22c3efa1e) and Verifier check indicate this is a minimum follow-up of 2.5 years, not median. This affects the time_factor calculation (0.697) and power assumptions.
issues.request: Clarify whether followup_years should be minimum (2.5) or estimated median follow-up; search for median follow-up in IMPROVE-IT publications before 2014-11-17

issues.issue: No placebo-adjusted phase 2 LDL-C change for ezetimibe 10mg added to statin therapy exists in verified facts. Per protocol, this is the accepted input before outcome trial results are published. All verified phase 2 add-on facts (f_b5b3e06549e90c, f_69cb0f217fb6b5, f_fa21c91d954bee, f_51ac611ca2195c) show 'None percent' and placebo_adjusted=false. The calculator correctly has null, but a quantified input should have been provided.
issues.request: Search for placebo-controlled phase 2 trial of ezetimibe 10mg added to statin (simvastatin or atorvastatin) reporting LDL-C percent change at 6-12 weeks before 2014-11-17

issues.issue: Hypotheses reference 'calculator' as a source for multiple claims (e.g., 'MDE HR at 80% power is 0.926', 'mechanism prediction not computable'). 'calculator' is not a verified fact; claims should reference the calculator result object or verified facts directly.
issues.request: Replace 'calculator' references with specific calculator result fields (e.g., 'calculator.mde_hr_80') or verified fact citations
